paite: Huai khit in Joshua in Reuben pawlte, Gad pawlte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte asam hi.
heading: Joshua In Suahlam Namte A-inn Uah Asawl

paite: Akiang uah, "TOUPA sikha Mosi in hon thupiak peuhmah na zuita ua, ke'n thu ka hon piak peuhmah leng na zuita uhi.
Tuni tanpha in na unaute uh na taisan kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hih dia thu ahon piak na zuita uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un akiang ua ana gensa bang in, na unaute uh muanna apeta hi. Huaiziak in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan gal a na tantuam ding ua hon piaksa gam ah, na puanin kaihte uah pai nawnta un.

TOUPA sikha Mosi in TOUPA na Pathian uh it a, alampi tengteng tawn a, athupiakte zui a, amah len tinten a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na kha tengteng ua amah nna sem chiatchiat dia hon thupiakte, huai thupiak leh dante pilvangtak in limsak un," achi hi.
Joshua in amau avualzawl a, apaisakta hi. Huchi in apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.

Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in Bashan gam ah tantuam apia a; akimkhat dangte Joshua in tumlam pang ah Jordan gal ah a-unaute lak ah tantuam ape zawta hi. Joshua in a-inn lam ua apaisak dek lai in avualzawl hi.

Akiang uah, "Na puanin lam uah hauhsakna tamtak toh paita unla, ganta tampi toh, dangka toh, dangka-eng toh, dal toh, sik toh, silh-le-ten tampi toh. Na melmate ua pan na gallakte uh unaute toh kihawm dialdial un," achi hi.

Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte akik nawn ua, Kanaan gam Shiloh a pan Israel suante kiang a pan Gilead gam, TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu a na piak bang in amau tantuam ding mawng a sehsa gam a pai ding in apawtkheta uhi.
Kanaan gam a Jordan gamgi ava tun un Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Jordan lui gei ah maitam lianpi kholang mahmah khat adoh uhi.
heading: Jordan Pang A Maitam

paite: Ngai in, Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Kanaan gam chin tak, Jordan gamgi, Israel suante gam lam pang ah maitam adoh uh, chih Israelte kiang ah kuahiam khat in ava hilh hi.
Israel suante'n hiai thu azak un, Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng amaute dou tum in Shiloh ah akikhawm uhi.
Israel suante'n Gilead gam a Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas asawl uhi.
Milian sawmkhat, Israel nam a inkuan a lupente'n Phinehas azui uhi.
Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, akiang uah,
huchi in TOUPA mi omkhawm tengteng in, "Bangziak a tuni a TOUPA tung a hel tum a maitam doh a, TOUPA lehngatsan na hi ua?" achi uhi.
"Peor mun a tatsiatnate, ei a dia neu lua a sim theih ahi maw? Tuni tan in leng huai a i khelhna ua pan silsiang i hi nai kei ua, TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi alen tanpha in leng.
Tuni a TOUPA lehngatsan na tup maizen uh? Huchi in tuni in TOUPA tung ah na na helta maimah ua, zingchiang a zaw Israel mipi omkhawm tengteng tung a amah heh ding ahita ve.

Na gam luah uh siang lou ahihleh, TOUPA gam, TOUPA biakbuk omna mun ah hong pai unla, ka lak uah hong teng un. Himahleh TOUPA i Pathian un achih louh maitam dang bawl in TOUPA tung ah hel kei unla, kou tung ah leng hel kei un.
Zer tapa Akan in hamsiat thil ah ana hihkhial a, Israel mipi tengteng tung ah hehna ahong om ahi kei maw? Huai mi tatsiatna ah amah kia amangthang tuam kei hi," achi uhi.
Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Israel nam a intekpente adawng ua, akiang uah,

"TOUPA, pathiante' Pathian, pathiante TOUPA Pathian in athei. Israel pawl in leng thei hen! Ka maitam doh uh TOUPA lehngatsan a, hel tupna hiam thilhihkhelh tupna hiam a ka hih uleh, tuni in leng hon hawi kei un,
halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, lemna thillatna ding hiam ahihleh, TOUPA mahmah in thukhen hen.
Tunung chiang in na suante un ka suante uh kiang ah, Nou TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian na zat phakna uh bang om ahia?

Nou Reuben suante leh Gad suante aw, TOUPA'N kou leh nou a ding in Jordan gamgi ding in abawl hi. TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh, ahon chi kha ding uh, chi a, pilvan ziak a aziak neitak a ka hih uh ahi. Na suante un kou suante TOUPA laudan thei lou in abawl kha thei uhi.
Huaiziak in kisa un, maitam i bawl ding uh, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding bel hilou in.

Kou leh nou leh i nung ua i suante kikal ah theihpihna ahi dia, huchi in ka halmang thillatte uh leh ka kithoihnate uh leh ka lemna thillatte ua TOUPA nna ka septheihna ding uh leh na suante un leng tunung chiang a ka suante uh kiang a TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh ahon chihlouhna ding un, ka chi ua ahi.

Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, tunung chiang a ka kiang uh hiam, ka suante uh kiang uh hiam a huchibang a ahon chih chiang ua kou, 'En ve ua, ka pipute un TOUPA maitam abawl uh omdan, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding ahi kei a, kou leh nou kikal a theihpihna ahi zaw hi,' ka chihna ding ua, ka hih uh ahi.

TOUPA tung a hel a TOUPA lehngatsan a, TOUPA ka Pathian uh maitam, abiakbuk chin a maitam kia lou halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, theihpihna ding hiam a maitam bawl ka hihlouhdan uh," achi uhi.
Siampu Phinehas leh akiang a omkhawmte' miliante, Israel pawl nam intekpente'n Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte thugen azak un akipaksak mahmah hi.

Siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas in Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte kiang ah, "TOUPA tung a thil na hihkhelh louh ziak un, tu'n zaw TOUPA i lak ua om ngeina ahi, chih ka theita ve ua. Huchi in Israel suante TOUPA khut a pan na hunkheta uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas leh milian pawl, Reuben suante leh Gad suante a pan leh Gilead gam a pan Kanaan gam ah Israel suante kiang ah akik nawnta ua, thu ava tun nawn uhi.
Huai thute'n Israel suante akipaksak mahmah a; Israel suante'n Pathian aphatta uh. Huchi in Reuben suante leh Gad suante dou a, atenna gam uh suksiatsak ding in kuankhiak atum nawn kei uhi.
Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n huai maitam pen, "theihpihtu,” achi uhi. "TOUPA, Pathian a na hi ngei chih i kikal ua theihpihtu ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
